_note: A deliberately thin seed. Nine labels covering the things every restaurant review touches, chosen so the first collection has somewhere to put its reviews without inventing subjects nobody has raised. The real vocabulary gets authored from the collected reviews, and auto-promotion grows it from there. Resist padding this list: a theme that fires on the wrong reviews is worse than no theme at all, which is the lesson of the Library's ai_criticism label.

themes.label: food_quality
themes.description: How the food itself tasted, was cooked, or was seasoned

themes.label: service
themes.description: Staff attentiveness, warmth, competence, or the lack of it

themes.label: wait_time
themes.description: Queueing, time to be seated, time to be served

themes.label: value
themes.description: Price against what arrived on the plate

themes.label: menu_range
themes.description: How much choice there was, including when something had run out

themes.label: atmosphere
themes.description: The room: light, noise, comfort, how it feels to sit in

themes.label: indigenous_menu
themes.description: The Native culinary tradition the restaurant is built on

themes.label: hours
themes.description: When the kitchen opens and closes, including stopping service early
